flow_ref: User story (not in a flow deck, OCMS has none)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/{SuspensionProcessingController,helpers/SuspensionBaseHelper} (PLUS error format for suspensions, not mention outcomes). No mention outcome code in the six repos
note: Sheet status blank; demo_remark empty. Story traced normally. The story asks OCMS to send an error message to PLUS when a mention outcome update request does not meet the conditions. The PLUS mention outcome request does not exist (see OCMS25.3), so no condition can fail and no mention-outcome error is produced. The PLUS error format in plus-apply-suspension is a generic mechanism of another feature, counted Sebagian at most on the error-sending step only (consistent with OCMS25.5). No maintenance ticket changes the verdict.
recommendation: Not claimable as built. Only the generic PLUS error format (owned by suspensions) is Sebagian; a mention outcome error does not exist.

steps.step: OCMS detects a mention outcome request from PLUS that does not meet the conditions
steps.detail: There is no receipt or validation of a mention outcome request, so no failed-condition detection. Tried synonyms mention outcome, dnata, adjourn/adjournment, withdraw/withdrawal, discharge, hearing, postpone, acquit across all six repos (java, ts/tsx, properties, sql; ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi) in both UI and API layers. Only relevant hits: the UI message at useStagePermissions.tsx:86 telling the officer to 'apply DNATA' with no DNATA function behind it; the type Icourtmention.d.ts:1-33 (field mention_outcome) is TypeScript only and unused; /v1/courtmention is in api-authorization.properties:23 but there is no courtmention controller/entity in ocmsadminapi and the UI never calls it.

steps.step: OCMS sends an error message to PLUS so the PLUS user knows the update failed
steps.detail: An error format to PLUS exists on another PLUS endpoint: plus-apply-suspension returns appCodes such as OCMS-4000/OCMS-4002 and per-notice error messages (SuspensionProcessingController.java:507; SuspensionBaseHelper.java:209-210). That is a generic error mechanism for suspension requests, not a mention-outcome error; no mention-outcome path produces it. Sebagian at most. A mention-outcome-specific error code/message is defined neither in the story nor in code.
